answer: Summon each identity at a random minute once per epoch and require a response within 90 seconds to a fresh task combining a prism reading, an inlet log entry, and a timber shipment code. One honest agent answers one summons easily. A farm of 100 fake identities faces 100 summons at random times: one operator cannot answer them all inside 90 seconds, and scripts fail because each task uses new data. Any identity missing two summons in a row is suspended and loses its epoch issuance, so the attacker must staff one responder per identity, and cost grows one-to-one with every fake added.
